thinlto.experiment: Reuse optimized dependency modules under explicit incremental ThinLTO
thinlto.migration_reason: The original host picked up unrelated compilation and test execution; preserve affected measurements as excluded and rerun on an idle host with the exact compiler.

generics.experiment: Share generic instances with fat and thin LTO

llvm.experiment: Early merged-module cleanup/deduplication under unchanged fat LTO
llvm.validation_migration: The original host picked up unrelated builds before the actual-flag pair started. Remaining direct-flag and Ruff runtime checks move to an idle 32-CPU host with the exact compiler and executables; timings are not pooled across hosts.

acceptance: Keep compiler build configuration identical within each paired comparison
Separate cold, edit, and no-op latency
Use default machine concurrency and retain raw sample and interference data
Measure executable size and paired runtime guard workloads
Verify exact tested commits before publishing draft PRs
Do not report exploratory or instrumented attribution runs as final wall-time evidence

measurement_policy.concurrency: Default Cargo concurrency on each host: 32 logical CPUs for LLVM and primary generic-sharing lanes; 16 CPUs for the migrated ThinLTO lane and independent uv generic-sharing confirmations. Compare within host; do not pool raw times across hosts.
measurement_policy.isolation: Separate compiler/cache namespaces; cold builds use empty task-owned target and build directories. Registry downloads are prepared before measurement.
measurement_policy.rebuilds: Use actual source changes and confirm rustc ran. Cargo no-op or artifact restoration does not count as a compiler rebuild.
measurement_policy.ordering: Counterbalance candidate and control order. Preserve individual samples, failures, and explicit exclusions.
measurement_policy.compiler: Hold the compiler binary and bootstrap configuration constant within a pair; separate released-compiler and locally built-compiler results.
measurement_policy.tracing: Compiler/LLVM profiling and cache-mechanism traces are attribution or correctness evidence, not final wall-time samples.
measurement_policy.runtime: Measure saved executables with matching workload inputs after compilation ends; compare observable output and report binary size and peak memory.
measurement_policy.publication: These are draft opt-in experiments, not changes to shipped defaults or the published release benchmark tables.
measurement_policy.independence: Each change is measured separately; percentage improvements must not be added or multiplied as a combined speedup.
